book.name: Salmos
book.title: Israelchich Apanlleem yaseerangana anu Israelchich Apanlleem yaseerangana anu

content: Yuwamand Apanll iyaa nayaniku anumand yaseekaniya
Yuwapur Dapiyarini muxar tamapari ashiru undararish, kurak Abimelekush taarangu, anpur nee yaseesish yandarangiya.

content.text: Apaa, nuw shiyaa urutari, Wappari aturi,
ichingaru zari taakina.
Nuw urutari shiyaa ungirtakuri, mangi kis yaseekuri, taakina.
Nuw shiyaa ungirtakuri, tputs putit tamatarpari ashiruri,
mangi kis shambatkuri shiyaa yaseekina, Apaa.
Siysa tputsis mazinangtsa yuwaa nuw Apanllee yaseeki anootsi.
Ashiriya, na ichingaruni washunand yaseeyani.
Apanlleetsimari wanasirimshee ungirtayani, nuw siyaa atina.
Nuwsha Apanllee, Nuwaam istanganda, táranguri,
nuwaa istarangiya.
Nuw kapungtaa puniranguri,
itaru Apanllsha nuwaa tapachindarangiya.
Yuw tputs Apanllimun mang' tatkana, anin mang' ksakanaya.
¿Ayamtaatiya Apanllee pazichazinllinaja?
Urutari mang' kis taachinlliniya.
Nuw kapungtaa puniranguri, itaru nuwsha,
Apaa, Nuwaa tapachindanda, táranguri, kapung kuruziranguri,
Apanllsha nuwaa kuki mazinarangu, nuwaam mangooz mapiymash panarangiya.
Yuw tputs Apanllimun mang' tatkana anoo Apanll istakiya.
Apanll waana tiptsiree ksutkiya.
Apanllee chínash izuuru yasangtsa,
watam kizpur chinakuwa.
Yuw tputs Apanllee chinakana, an mang' ksakanaya.
Apanllee mangiptis zurampatarit chinangtsa.
Ashkachus, Apanllsha siyaa ksutchiya.
Tumuz wip wanir nda katungtsee yaku,
marizimunsha kiyung kachiychinlliniya.
Itaru, yuwsha tputs Apanllee chinaku,
anoomsha nda katungats pishtachiya.
Ashiriya, naanints nlluris. Nuwaa kuki mazinangtsa.
Apanllish wanasiri tachitamaam tayaspatachintspa.
Siy zapan masach mapiyrus taamaam zandkinaareesa,
Ashiri nda mantsir tsiyatamaam saanaatsis wanasir ksutangtsa.
Ngutis tputsee tamasingarus ngichintspa.
Yutaritshishee kasayarus, wanasir chinangtsa.
Mangis kis taamaam taarashish wanasirimsheetsimari chinangtsa.
Ashiriya, siysa mangis kis taapi atinaareesa,
Apanllee chinangtsa, nuw siyaa atina.
Yuw tputs Apanllee chinakana, anoo Apanllsha urutamari ksutkiya.
Yuwaa mashkana anoo Apanll uru mazinakiya.
Itaru, yuw tputs yutaritshisheetsimari chinaku, anoo nduntam Apanll istakiya.
Waani yachimbanllina átu, nda pakchiyam istamaam zandkiya; izuuru mapiykiya.
Itaru, yuwsha tputs Apanllee chinaku, ansha kiyung kachiykachu, Apanlleetssha mashku,
Apanllsha anoo mazinakchu, tapachindakiya.
Apanll waanaatsi tiptsiri uru kapung istamaam zandkiya.
Tputssha kapung mang' mantsaku, waani itamsamaam pinasaku, anoo waana Apanllsha tuwizpurtakiya.
Tputs Apanllee mangpatari chinaku, kapung kiyung kachiykitaa,
Apanllsha anoo istaku tapachindakiya.
Apanll waanaa tiptsiri kizpur ksutku, wanap nda minamtiyam ichipchiya.
Yutaritshishpansha tputs waanamandari yutaritshishirini tsipachinlliniya.
Apanllee tiptsiri natsaksin, Apanllsha anumand izuuru wanichiya.
Itaru, Apanll urutamari tiptsiree tapachindachiya.
Yuw tputs Apanllee chinakana, anoo nda wanichiya.
Ayamtaatiya tiptsiree wanicheeja, ndambaree.

content: Ashirucha, nuwaa kuki mazinangtsa. Watam nuw siyaa tayaspatakuri atinawa.

footnotes.text: Yuwaa nish átu anootstam 1 Pitoru 3.10-12 tayusima kamankiya.
2 Koríndshucheema 1.8-10; 2 Tímoteyooma 3.10-12 tsiyatsis nipta tatsamooru taaritamta.
Yuwaa nish átu anootstam Wanga 19.36 tayusima kamankiya.
